title: DICOM (Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine) signature
summary: A DICOM file begins with a 128-byte preamble (usually zeros) followed by the 4-byte signature 'DICM' (0x44 0x49 0x43 0x4D) at offset 128.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Followed by DICOM data elements (tag, VR, length, value).
DICOM is the standard for medical imaging (X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound).
